title: Ordinary realization on the shared total functor
statement: For an additive tensor equivalence L between preadditive monoidal categories with countable colimits, assemble the existing ordinary total tensor comparison as a natural transformation whose source is the shared total tensor functor. Its component equals the specified finiteScalarTotalTensorIsoOfOrdinary component. Specialize this construction to the actual scalar realization.

source.place: Tags 06YN and 07A4; signed total tensor and localization tensorators

proof.text: Use the specified total tensor comparison for each component. Its published naturality proves naturality for the shared total functor. Unfold the natural-transformation constructor to identify every component with the published map, then specialize to the scalar coefficient equivalence and its actual ordinary tensor isomorphism.

lean.statement:
def finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalRealizationForFunctor
    {C D : Type*} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Category.{u + 1} D]
    [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D] [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalPreadditive D]
    [Limits.HasColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} C] [Limits.HasColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) [L.Additive] [L.IsEquivalence]
    (o : tensor C ⋙ L ≅ (L.prod L) ⋙ tensor D) :
    finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalTensor C ⋙ L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⟶
      ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        uncurry.obj ((curriedTensor D).map₂HomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))
